sents.t: To all employees of Benton Manufacturing:
The east parking lot will be repaved from July 10 to July 12.
During this time, please park in the west lot or at City Garage on Elm Street.
The company will pay for City Garage parking; simply show your employee ID at the exit.
Cars left in the east lot will be moved at the owner's expense.
This includes the blue van that has not moved since 2019.
